description: This file implements the transformation logic for Azure Document Intelligence OCR integration, including request formatting, response parsing, and async operation handling within a larger OCR processing framework.

classes.name: AzureDocumentIntelligenceOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for transforming OCR requests and responses using Azure Document Intelligence API v4.0.

methods.name: list get_supported_ocr_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns supported OCR parameters for the Azure DI API, which are minimal compared to other OCR services.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for Azure Document Intelligence based on model and base URL.

methods.description: Extracts base64 content from a data URI scheme.

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms a Mistral OCR request document into Azure DI expected JSON format.

methods.name: str _extract_page_markdown(self, page_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates text lines from Azure DI page data to markdown.

methods.name: OCRPageDimensions _convert_dimensions( self, width: float, height: float, unit: str )
methods.description: Converts dimensions from inches to pixels based on configured DPI.

methods.name: None _check_timeout(start_time: float, timeout_secs: int)
methods.description: Checks if polling exceeds the given timeout duration.

methods.name: int _get_retry_after(response: httpx.Response)
methods.description: Reads retry-after header for polling interval.

methods.name: str _check_operation_status(response: httpx.Response)
methods.description: Parses the operation status from Azure DI polling response.

methods.name: httpx.Response _poll_operation_sync( self, operation_url: str, headers: Dict[str, str], timeout_secs: int, )
methods.description: Synchronously polls the operation endpoint until completion or timeout.

methods.name: httpx.Response _poll_operation_async( self, operation_url: str, headers: Dict[str, str], timeout_secs: int, )
methods.description: Asynchronously polls the operation endpoint until completion or timeout.

methods.name: OCRResponse transform_ocr_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: Any, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the Azure DI JSON response into the standard Mistral OCR format.

methods.name: OCRResponse async_transform_ocr_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: Any, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of response transformation, handling async polling.
